## Compare donkeys at the same heart girth

Build the model one term at a time. Move the heart-girth marker to compare
fitted mean body weights at the same heart girth. Then change the reference
categories and watch what changes, and what does not.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
multipleRegressionLab({ Plot, data: donkeyWidgetData })
```

::: {.mr-slide-note}
Use **Heart girth** first, then add **Age group**, then **Sex**. Ask students to
watch ordinary and adjusted R-squared as each term enters. Finally change the
reference categories: the factor coefficients change sign/coding, but the
fitted values at the marker stay fixed. All group lines remain parallel because
this is an additive model with no interactions.
:::
